prior_summary: A learned finite-context event posterior and state-dependent residual-duration hazards condition an epsilon-predicting joint-action diffusion model. Soft stay/advance belief propagation encourages event persistence without a trajectory clock. Training-only command/geometry annotations, right-censored future event targets and a soft ordered-transition loss align the full red-release to blue-transfer to red-reacquisition sequence.
applicable_conditions: The demonstrated ordered, unbranched buffer swap, with causal world-frame robot/object/goal state at 20 Hz. Entry may occur during held red descent, red release/retreat, blue open approach, closure or lift anywhere in the incoming overlap. The initial event posterior is inferred from observations, not set to the first phase. No images, trajectory identity or elapsed invocation time are used.
termination_guidance: Continue through blue placement and release, open retreat, buffered red approach, closure and initial red lift. A useful successor state has blue supported at its negative-y goal and red rising with the closed fingers near the TCP; stored endpoints show red heights around 0.17-0.21 m with nonzero joint velocity. Phase uncertainty is supplementary, not a contact certificate or a stop rule. The task completion contract remains red_at_goal AND blue_at_goal without additional release, clearance or velocity requirements.
limitations: The interface supplies only two causal frames and has no persistent event-memory or sampler hook. This is a finite-context approximation to the semi-Markov hypothesis: learned current-state initialization, one observed recurrent update and 14-step residual hazards, not an elapsed-event clock. Exact whole-event progress and uniform event sampling are replaced by a censored boundary-proximity target and bounded inverse-count loss weighting. Weak labels assume the demonstrated event order; retry and slip recovery are unestablished. No hard contact, invariance, IK or passive-object constraint is implemented.

config.architecture: EventDiffusionPolicy with the public Conditional U-Net
events: red opening, retreat and transfer toward blue
blue goal alignment, descent and held setdown
blue opening, retreat and transfer toward red
config.action_representation: Shared affine normalized absolute seven-joint targets and gripper command; no time warping
config.normalization: Unmodified shared normalizer fitted on all complete original demonstrations; relative position scales are the per-axis maximum of shared TCP/red/blue position half ranges
config.sampling_adaptation: Use repository random causal windows over every expanded slice; approximate event balancing with bounded inverse current-minibatch event-frequency loss weights, without resampling or skipping phases
config.selection: Last EMA after the fixed 20000 updates, seed 0; no performance-based selection
